summary.text: David Crowley is the Milwaukee County Executive, a position he has held since May 2020, and the Democratic nominee for governor with running mate Secretary of State Sarah Godlewski. He previously served in the Wisconsin Assembly from 2017 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Born in Milwaukee in 1986 and a graduate of Bay View High School; earned a bachelor's degree in community engagement and education from the University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee in December 2024.

Worked as a campaign organizer for Russ Feingold's 2010 re-election campaign, then as a legislative aide to Milwaukee County Supervisor Nikiya Harris Dodd and, after she was elected to the state Senate in 2012, as her policy director.
Elected to the Wisconsin Assembly (17th District) in 2016 and re-elected in 2018; resigned in June 2020 to serve as county executive, as state law bars holding both offices.
Elected Milwaukee County Executive in April 2020 and re-elected in 2024.
